answered.sql: SELECT A.id, A.fullname FROM Actor A JOIN Movie M ON A.id = M.LeadActorId GROUP BY A.id, A.fullname ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 1 UNION ALL SELECT AA.id, AA.fullname FROM Actress AA JOIN Movie M ON AA.id = M.LeadActressId GROUP BY AA.id, AA.fullname ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 1
